name: Twenty Squares board from Ur
description: A decorated twenty-square board deposited at Ur documents a Mesopotamian board-game tradition.

impact.note: One deposited board witnessing a game tradition already played; nothing later is known to rest on this object itself.

date.label: Approximately 2600–2400 BCE
date.basis: British Museum dates its excavated object to the range.

events.statement: A twenty-square game board was deposited in the Royal Cemetery at Ur.
events.scope: An individual board dates the object, not the invention of the game; the pieces for this specific board have not survived. Rules reconstructed from later evidence need not describe its original play.
